content.title: LOBO EV enters supply agreement for Ukraine market
content.summary: LOBO EV (LOBO) entered into a significant international supply agreement with one international commercial company based in Ukraine. The agreement, signed on March 1, marks a major milestone in LOBO’s international expansion strategy in Eastern Europe. Under the terms of the contract, LOBO EV Technologies will deliver a total of 5,500 electric vehicles to Ukraine, including 4,000 standard electric bicycles and 1,500 three-wheeled EVs. The total contract value is approximately $1,575,000. Publish
